description: Quais et pontons présents sur les canaux appartenant à la région Bretagne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by kartenn.region-bretagne.fr. Characteristics of the docks and pontoons on the Domaine Public Fluvial (DPF) belonging to the Brittany region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Docks and pontoons on canals belonging to the Brittany region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include quai, ponton, canal, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2019-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
